name: family-office-residency-regimes-compared
description: Compare special tax residence regimes for wealthy, internationally mobile families: Malta remittance basis and Global Residence Programme, Italy's flat tax on foreign income for new residents, Portugal's IFICI, Swiss taxation on expenditure, UAE tax residence, Singapore overseas income, the UK four-year foreign income and gains regime, Ireland's remittance basis and domicile levy, and Cyprus non-dom status with the lump-sum option. Covers who qualifies, annual cost, duration, what each regime does not shelter, and a checklist for choosing a base.
